problem.title: InTEn-LOAM KITTI Odom seq 01 full (1101 frames): S2S ground without forward information
problem.question: Does removing the forward component of the S2S ground Jacobian (s2s_ground_no_forward, not in the paper) change full-sequence accuracy with the fixed paper_odometry_plane_check setting?

variants.label: Paper odometry + plane check (fresh reference)
variants.intent: Fixed Table 6 setting (07-selected 0.17 deg correction and 0.05 m S2M plane check), rerun on the same binary as the candidate.

variants.label: Paper odometry + plane check + S2S ground without forward (not in the paper)
variants.intent: Same setting; S2S ground residuals give no information along the sensor's forward axis (s2s_ground_no_forward=1). Opt-in, default off; chosen on development sequences 01/02.
